text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, everyone! It's gonna start! Hurry, 
hurryyy!

The night of the summer festival. We all 
decided to go watch a certain event being 
held.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
By the way, regarding today's event... 
what exactly is a motorcycle "quarter-mile 
race"?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Drag racing is a special kind of race 
where you compete for the best time on a 
400-meter straight.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The flashy burst of it is pretty sick, 
but... is an amateur festival sideshow 
really worth watching?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's probably just some petty game 
anyway...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just an old soba delivery guy racing on a 
stock moped, nothing more...
(Vroom, vroom, VRRRROOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...? This engine sound is... !?

"I heard the sound of a high-displacement 
engine that couldn't possibly belong to a 
delivery bike..."
(Vroom, vroom, VRRRROOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, for real?! They all look 
like amateurs, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All these well-maintained bikes gathered 
here. Man... we hit the motherlode!

And so began the race of just ten seconds. 
It was a truly white-hot contest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaah, awesome! A new record~! At the 
end, the chassis was all like *GWAAAH*!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*cough cough*, there is so much smoke. It 
is a little frightening...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The very last machine... Can I do it? Is 
it really possible?
(VRROOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She passed her! Are you kidding me?! A 
massive comeback victory by 0.2 seconds!!

text_block_list.name: Drag Race Participant
text_block_list.text:
Man, ya got me. Guess you paid me back for 
last year.

text_block_list.name: Drag Race Winner
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The grip on the tires felt 
completely different, right? Come on, 
let's have a toast!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see... Just for one summer... Just for 
those ten seconds, these people...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Seriously so cool... Who knew the 
countryside had such a hype festival?
choice_data_list: That was a fiercely contested battle.
That was quite a fierce battle, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, somehow... this really hits deep. 
Trainer, I wanna shine just as bright and 
not lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"This acceleration... and this sheer 
ferocity! I'll never damn well forget it!"

It seems Vodka found her summer gem at the 
drag race. And then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, this time it's our turn to shine! 
Teio, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who can look the coolest at the 
night stalls. Come on, what're we 
competing in?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How simple-minded. Even though you looked 
so bored at first.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A moment of coolness, huh? Maybe the 
shooting gallery after all? Goldfish 
scooping? Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Should we let Trainer decide here? Which 
one looks like it'll be a good match?

Looking at the shop curtain, I think it 
over. A contest of instantaneous coolness. 
What looks fun is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Baby castella? How're we supposed to 
compete with that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look, Vodka! That's not baby castella, 
it's *heavy* castella!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look look, a suuuper giant, heavy 
castella! Can you even carry that~?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the!? Look at the size of that 
thing... Are you serious? It's like a 
giant boulder.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"If that thing's stuffed with red bean 
paste, it's game over. You really think 
you can lift it?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! In that case, let's do this! I'm 
gonna shine this summer too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll show those drag-racing old men power 
they can't beat!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Uryaaaaah! Whooooah, this is so heavyyyy! 
What is this thing?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And I can't see anything around me! 
Whoa-whoa-whoa!?

Vodka carries the ultra-heavy Heavy 
Castella through sheer stubbornness. It 
seems to have made for a great workout.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A lottery, huh? Nice, it really feels like 
everything rides on a single flash of 
inspiration...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that'll be our showdown! Everyone 
draws one!
And so, after each of them drew once...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I won the 'Combining Robot DX'. Is it a 
good item?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won a toy crown! Yaaay, I'm gonna wear 
it and play around at training camp♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaah?! "Fireworks Cinders"?! That's 
clearly a totally dud prize!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, just watch! One more time! I'll 
show you how cool I can look finishing it 
in an instant!

Afterward, Vodka drew the lottery over and 
over again. As much as she squandered her 
money to the limit, her grit was forged.
